spec.description: Current order book for one market: every bid and ask level, best price first.

request.title: GetOrderBookRequest
request.description: The market to fetch an order book for, and how to group its levels.

group.description: Whether orders at the same price are merged into one level: `0` lists every order separately, `1` groups them into one level per price. Defaults to `1`.

response.title: OrderBook
response.description: Order book snapshot, bids and asks each sorted best price first.

timestamp.description: When this snapshot was taken, to the second.

microtimestamp.description: When this snapshot was taken, to the microsecond.

notes: Bitstamp documents a third `group` value, `2`, which prepends each level's order id and returns three-element rows (`[price, amount, order_id]`) instead of the two-element `OrderBookLevel` this schema declares -- verified live. The request enum stops at `1` deliberately: declaring `2` would need a row shape this endpoint's schema cannot express without breaking `0`/`1`, and a caller who passes it anyway gets a response that fails validation against this schema rather than one this spec silently mis-describes.
